Title: BYD is beating Tesla on price in 10 places outside the West
Meta_Description: While Tesla focuses its sales in North America and Europe, BYD is expanding in Latin America and Southeast Asia. 2024 was a big year for Chinese ...
Headings: h1: How BYD undercuts Tesla around the world, by the numbers; h3: BYD is more affordable than Tesla in at least 10 places outside the West.; h4: Beats; h4: Regions; h4: Sections; h4: Learn more; h4: Follow us; h4: Dark Mode; h5: Explore by; h5: EV Revolution
Page_Content: ['2024 was a big year for Chinese automakerBYDiBYDBYD Auto is a Chinese carmaker that became the world’s leading EV manufacturer in 2023, competing with Tesla for market share and global attention.READ MORE. The company secured its position as the biggest electrified-car maker in the world. It made waves for earning morerevenuethan Tesla for the first time in the third quarter of the year, anddeliveredmore fully electric vehicles than Tesla for the first time in the fourth quarter.', 'BYD is particularly competitive with Tesla in non-Western countries, where Tesla sometimes has a more limited footprint and where the Chinese giant undercuts its American competitor on price. A newRest of Worldanalysis of prices for the companies’ lowest-cost vehicles looks at 10 non-Western countries and regions where both officially sell their vehicles, and where they offer prices up-front on their websites: Mexico, Chile, the United Arab Emirates, mainland China, Hong Kong, South Korea, Japan, Thailand, Malaysia, and Singapore. In Singapore, the price of the BYD Dolphin includes the cost of acertificate of entitlement, a government-mandated license that allows one to own and use a car for 10 years. Tesla’s prices don’t include the cost of the certificate, andRest of Worldhas adjusted the price to reflect it.', 'BYD’s most affordable model varies by locale — it is either the Seagull (also known as the Dolphin Mini in some markets), the Dolphin, or the Atto 3 — while Tesla’s lowest-cost offering in all 10 countries is the Model 3.Rest of Worldcompared prices as of February 27, 2025, and converted them to U.S. dollars to make comparisons.', 'Tesla’s Model 3 is more premium than BYD’s cheapest offerings, George Whitcombe, an analyst at EV intelligence firm Rho Motion, toldRest of World. (The BYD Seal is considered the mostsimilarto the Tesla Model 3 in terms of class and performance.) For years, Tesla has promised and failed to make a low-cost, entry-level EV. On an October 2024 earnings call, Tesla CEO Elon Musksaidthe company is on track to make affordable models available in the first half of 2025. Meanwhile, buyers around the world looking for affordable EVs have been turning to Chinese manufacturers like BYD.', 'BYD isreportedlyseeking to be more competitive in China by asking its suppliers to reduce prices, while it also looks to set up more factories outside of its home base. Doing so would reduce export costs, and potentially BYD’s global prices. “Being able to compete on cost is a huge thing in the Chinese EV market,” said Whitcombe. “And then, as BYD expands globally, the knock-on effect is that the vehicles are able to be produced cheaply.”', 'Being able to compete on cost is a huge thing in the Chinese EV market.', 'The prices for Tesla cars included inRest of World’s analysis come from the website of the company, which sells directly to consumers. BYD, meanwhile, partners with local distributors and dealerships to sell its cars in regions like Africa, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia — a cost-efficient option that allows the company to tap into a distributor’s existing sales infrastructure. The prices listed on BYD’s website for the 10 countries and regions used in this analysis are “suggested retail costs” that may vary on the ground.', 'Singapore is the only countryRest of Worldmeasured where there’s little difference in price between Tesla’s Model 3 and BYD’s Dolphin. It’s very expensive to own any car in Singapore because of the country’s requirement for a certificate of entitlement. Despite the similarity in price between its cheapest model and that of Tesla, BYD was thebest-sellingcar brand in Singapore last year.', 'After Singapore, Japan sees the smallest difference in price between the two carmakers, but Tesla’s Model 3 is still nearly $12,000 more expensive than BYD’s Dolphin. In Thailand, Tesla’s offering is more expensive than that of BYD by the widest margin — the Model 3 costs over $30,000 more than the Dolphin.', 'One factor in BYD’s favor is that its most affordable cars, especially the Seagull and the Dolphin, are smaller than Tesla’s Model 3. This allows BYD to use smaller and cheaper batteries, said Whitcombe. The battery is the most expensive part of an electric vehicle.', 'BYD does not sell cars in the U.S., whichimposeda 100% tariff on Chinese EVs in September 2024. Three of the 10 countries and regions inRest of World’s analysis have also imposed tariffs on Chinese EVs, according to the Market Access Map from the International Trade Centre, a joint agency between the World Trade Organization and the United Nations: theUAEat 5%,Chileat 6%, andSouth Korea, where BYD just launched in January, at 8%.', 'Tesla is primarily focused on sales in the U.S. and Europe. The company doesn’t sell in any African or South Asian country, and only sells in two Latin American countries: Mexico and Chile. BYD, on the other hand, has expanded in several markets outside of Europe, particularly in Latin America and Southeast Asia, according to Whitcombe. Rho Motion found that around 60% of the EVs sold in Brazil last year were BYD models, he said.', '“They’re really looking to take hold of markets where other electric vehicle manufacturers are not yet expanding into — that seems to be their top priority,” said Whitcombe.', 'BYD is ramping up production outside China, where the cost of making EVs is relatively low. Whitcombe said he expects the company to have another big year in 2025 and that he is watching to see whether its global expansion will have a long-term impact on prices. “As production ramps up and volumes ramp up, it could be really interesting when BYD has a number of facilities globally where they can produce EVs at a much cheaper price than anyone else,” he said.']

Page_Content: ['BYDCo.’s sales last year surpassed the $100 billion mark, leapfrogging Elon Musk’sTeslaInc. on revenue, as the Chinese auto giant wows consumers with a range of electric and hybrid cars packed with high-tech features.', 'Shenzhen-based BYD reported revenue of 777 billion yuan ($107 billion) for the 12 months ended Dec. 31, up 29%, according to a filing late Monday, beating estimates for 766 billion yuan. Tesla’s 2024 revenue was $97.7 billion. The Chinese EV maker’s net income rose 34% year-on-year to 40.3 billion yuan, beating analyst estimates for 39.5 billion yuan.', 'BYD has risen quickly to the top of China’s car market — the world’s biggest and most competitive in terms of electric vehicles. This year alone, BYD has unveiled a new ecosystem that allows EVs to charge for 400 kilometers injust five minutesand introduced advanced driver assistance technology in even its most basic models. Investors have sent its shares to a record and BYD’s Hong Kong-listed stock is up around 51% this year.', 'BYD also sells about the same number of EVs as Tesla — 1.76 million in 2024 versus 1.79 million — but, when all of its other passenger hybrid car sales are included, it’s much larger. BYD’s total deliveries last year climbed to 4.27 million, almost as much asFord MotorCo.', 'BYD has forecast it can sell between 5 million to 6 million vehicles this year. It’s already off to a strong start, with sales in the first two months of 2025 up 93% year-on-year to 623,300 units.', 'Read More:Cheap Chinese Cars Are Taking Over Roads Around the World', 'One area where Tesla still clearly leads however is market valuation. The US carmaker is worth about $800 billion despite a share-price rout that’s seen the stock plunge 38% this year. BYD has a market capitalization closer to $157 billion.', 'Musk’s EV maker also makes more money on an absolute basis; Tesla’s net income last year was $7.6 billion.', 'But whereas Tesla is losing in China — shipments have been backsliding there for the past five consecutive months on a year-on-year basis — BYD is winning. China is still far and away BYD’s biggest market, where it commands a share ofalmost 15%, not just for new-energy vehicles but any sort of passenger car.', 'BYD doesn’t sell passenger cars in the US yet due to punitive tariffs on made-in-China automobiles, but it’s made big inroads into markets in Europe, places in Asia like Singapore and Thailand, as well as Australia.', 'Wang Chuanfu, BYD’s chairman and founder, said in a statement the company planned to keep boosting research and development while bolstering its product competitiveness, including in its focus of succeeding outside of China.', 'He also said that Chinese auto brands in the era of intelligence-led vehicles were no longer merely followers, but rather at the forefront of the trend. They’re “daring” to be first in the world and are collaborating with other domestic brands to go global and move up the value chain, he said.', '© 2025 Fortune Media IP Limited. All Rights Reserved. Title: BYD Throne, Dominating Global Electric Vehicles
Meta_Description: BYD controls 22.2 percent of the global market share for electric vehicle sales. Next, Tesla 10.3 percent and Wuling 4 percent.
Headings: h1: BYD Throne, Dominating Global Electric VehiclesÂ; h2: Indonesian Market; h2: BYD vs Tesla; h2: Potential
Page_Content: ['BYD controls 22.2 percent of the global market share for electric vehicle sales. Next, Tesla 10.3 percent and Wuling 4 percent.', "Chinese electric car manufacturer BYD has taken the top spot as the world's pure electric car or battery electric vehicle (BEV). BYD far surpasses its competitors, such as Tesla, Wuling, MBW, Volkswagen, and Mercedes-Benz.", 'Quoting the Autovista page, the global electric vehicle (EV) market recorded double-digit growth throughout 2024. If combined between electric vehicles (BEV) and plug-in hybrids (PHEV) it will reach more than 17.29 million units in 2024. This means that the global electric vehicle market grew 26.1 percent compared to 2023.', 'The latest data from EV Volumes (part of Autovista Group), BEV recorded a delivery registration volume of 10.8 million vehicles, while PHEV reached 6.49 million vehicles. Throughout 2024, BEV controlled the largest global electric vehicle market share reaching 62.5 percent and PHEV controlled 37.5 percent.', 'The first order or the one that dominates the global market share is the BYD brand with a total of 3.84 million vehicles, both BEV and PHEV electric vehicles. BYD controls 22.2 percent of all electric vehicle sales in the global market or up 1.2 percentage points from 2023.', "The second place is occupied by the American brand, Tesla, which managed to sell 1.78 million units or control 10.3 percent of the market share. Tesla's global market share fell 1.2 percent year-on-year (yoy). In 2023, Tesla's market share reached 13.2 percent.", 'In third place is Wuling, a manufacturer from China, with control of 4 percent of the global market or 688,415 units.', 'Meanwhile, BMW is in fourth place. Despite being one of the leading brands in Europe, BMW only controls 3.1 percent of the global EV market with sales of 535,586 vehicles.', 'Next, Li Auto is in fifth position with a 3 percent share of the global market or sales reaching 526,353 units. In sixth position, Geely with a 2.7 percent share or sales of 458,473 units.', 'Meanwhile, Volkswagen (VW) experienced a decline in sales so that it had to sit in seventh position with a market share of 2.6 percent or 454,631 units. In eighth place, Aito with sales reaching 386,817 units so that it controlled 2.2 percent of the global market share.', 'In ninth position, Mercedes-Benz controls 2.2 percent of the global market share with sales reaching 374,311 units. In tenth position, Aion, with sales reaching 373,906 units or controlling 2.2 percent of the global market share.', 'Entering 2025, globally, electric vehicle sales show a fairly rapid increase. Rho Motion, an electric vehicle research institute, revealed that the number of electric vehicles sold globally in February 2025 was 1.2 million units.', 'The electric vehicle market grew by almost 50 percent compared to February 2024, but fell by 3 percent compared to January 2025.', 'Rho Motion Data Manager Charles Lester, in his press release, said that global electric vehicle sales with a 50 percent increase were mostly due to growth from China which continues to experience the rise of electric vehicles.', 'â\x80\x9cTheir domestic brand, BYD, shows no signs of slowing down their domestic and international expansion,â\x80\x9d Lester said.', 'In the first two months of 2025, BYD has sold about 130,000 of its electric vehicles. Meanwhile, in Europe, battery electric cars also showed a 29 percent surge trend. Meanwhile, in North America, the growth was more stable at 20 percent.', "The US's largest BEV maker, Tesla, has had a tough start to the year, with January sales down 47 percent in Europe and 15 percent in China. Tesla's sales in France, Germany, the UK and Belgium fell 63 percent.", "Based on data from the European Automobile Manufacturers Association (ACEA), Tesla's sales in January 2025 were only 9,945 vehicles.", "BYD's dominance of the global market share is also seen in Indonesia. In total, electric car sales throughout 2024 rose 161 percent compared to the previous year in 2023.", 'Data from the Association of Indonesian Automotive Industries (Gaikindo) recorded that there were 44,557 vehicles distributed from factories to dealers or wholesalers. The data in 2024 increased from the previous year in 2023, which was 17,058 units.', 'BYD dominates the Indonesian market through nine models with total sales of 15,429 vehicles. Of the nine models, the best-selling cars are the BYD Seal Premium Extended Range with 3,125 units and the BYD Alto 3 Superior Extended Range with 3,068 units.', 'Another compatriot that has previously entered Indonesia, Wuling, is in second place with sales of 13,117 units. Of the total eight models, the Wuling Cloud 460 KM is the most in demand with 3,521 units and the Wuling Bingou 410 KM DC with 3,483 units.', 'Another Chinese manufacturer that dominates the Indonesian market is Chery with total sales of 5,010 units through its four models. Chery Omoda E5 is the most popular model, which is 4,250 units.', 'Next, Morris Garage, a British brand that recorded a total of 3,193 vehicles. Of its six models, the 4 EV Magnity CK D was the best-selling with 2,301 units and the ZS EV Magnity with 766 units.', 'Then, Hyundai, a manufacturer from Korea, with total sales of 2,803 units. Of the total 16 models, the Hyundai Ioniq 5 Signature Extended is the most popular, namely 1,299 units and the Hyundai Kona EV Signature Extended Two Tone 718 units.', 'The brand that also dominates the Indonesian market, namely Aion from China, sold 1,240 units with three models. Aion Y Plus Exclusive became the most popular model with 657 units.', 'Meanwhile, European brands, such as BMW (Germany) and CitroÃ«n (France), are also not far behind in dominating the Indonesian market. It is recorded that there are 679 BMW units in demand in Indonesia. The BMW IX1 eDrive20 AT is the best-selling with 295 units sold. Meanwhile, Citroen, which brought The New CitroÃ«n Ã\x8b-C3 All Electric, recorded sales of 361 units.', 'Other brands that are participating in enlivening the electric vehicle automotive market in Indonesia include Kia, Lexus, Mitsubishi Fuso, Mitsubishi Motor, DFSK, Mercedes Benz, Mini, Volvo Cars, Toyota, Seres, Nissan, and Neta.', 'In 2025, electric vehicles in Indonesia continue to grow. Most recently, in February 2025, Gaikindo recorded a total of 7,659 sales units (wholesales). BYD still recorded the highest sales in Indonesia at 2,513 units.', 'Followed by Wuling with 1,520 units and Chery with 1,371 units. Meanwhile, newcomer from China, Denza, recorded quite impressive sales reaching 937 units.', "According to automotive observer from the Bandung Institute of Technology (ITB), Yannes Martinus Pasaribu, BYD's global dominance, including in Indonesia in 2024 to early 2025, is due to a combination of mature industrial strategy, supply chain efficiency, and strong support from the Chinese government.", '"BYD has the advantage of its vertical business chain because it produces key components itself, such as batteries and electric motors, thereby reducing costs and improving quality control," said Yannes when contacted, Saturday (22/3/2025).', "Another thing that makes BYD attract a lot of attention is that it offers a wider portfolio of BEV variants, from entry level to premium class. From the various class variants, BYD offers attractive interior and exterior designs with embedded advanced features and technologies. From the various portfolios, BYD's price can be very competitive compared to other brands.", '"(BYD) uses a blade battery that is cheaper and more ethical in the supply chain. This also makes the total price of BYD cheaper," he said.', 'Meanwhile, manufacturers like Tesla are declining due to a complex interaction of market factors, operational factors, and depressed global macroeconomic conditions that have eroded market purchasing power in various countries.', 'Not to mention the US-China trade war, which will make Chinese people and many countries outside the G7 shift to BEV products whose performance is considered to exceed Tesla.', '"This situation is increasingly making Tesla lose its appeal. Because in addition to the challenges of Tesla\'s parts supply chain being disrupted by US trade and political policies, there are currently many cheaper electric vehicle products, design variants, and increasingly sophisticated technology," Yannes said.', '"Don\'t forget, many world-class product designers have joined China. Starting from former senior designers of Rolls Royce, BMW, Audio, and others, which makes Chinese products competitive in terms of technology, product design, price, and even after-sales guarantees," he continued.', 'So what about the potential of the electric vehicle market in Indonesia?', 'According to Yannes, there is still potential for the electric car market in Indonesia to grow. This is inseparable from the fact that Indonesia is in a transition phase towards the electric vehicle era. This potential is also seen at least from Gaikindo data which records positive growth in electric vehicles.', '"I estimate that the national electric car or BEV market share in 2025 will increase by 70,000 units in 2025 or around 8 percent of the projected total sales of all cars in Indonesia," said Yannes.', "The potential of the electric vehicle market in Indonesia could reach the target or even be higher than expected if Indonesia's macroeconomy is stable and the electric vehicle infrastructure continues to be improved.", 'The reason why many Indonesian consumers have yet to look at electric vehicles is because infrastructure such as charging or public electric vehicle charging stations (SPKLU) are not evenly distributed and do not reach wide areas.', 'Electric vehicles that are in demand in Indonesia are not only for the city travel segment other than in Jabodetabek (Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Tangerang, and Bekasi), but also for long-distance out-of-town travel.', 'Other infrastructure, the development of the domestic component level (TKDN) of the local battery industry must be supported by the government through sustainable fiscal and non-physical incentives so that it can reduce the price of electric vehicles.', 'Gaikindo Secretary General Kukuh Kumara said that the growth of electric vehicles globally and in Indonesia, in particular, is a trend towards the target of net zero emissions. Meanwhile, related to competition between Chinese and European/US brands, competition has emerged in terms of price.', 'Especially in Indonesia, price is very important. Chinese brands are often chosen because of their more affordable prices.', '"Indonesian people are very price sensitive consumers. Which (brand) is affordable. China because of its large volume and also has a way to reduce costs, in-depth research, and offers new concepts so that the price is competitive," Kukuh said.', "Kukuh believes that in 2025 the growth of electric or hybrid vehicles will still be promising. Even so, the purchasing power of the Indonesian people remains a challenge. If Indonesia's economic growth is positive, it will be in line with the increase in the growth of electric vehicles.", 'So, which brand of electric vehicle will you choose to fill your home garage?']
